title: JMS: explicit request/reply identity
summary: The FederationBank Java ATM uses TextMessage JSON request/reply with stable command identity, JMSCorrelationID, JMSReplyTo, a bounded receive timeout, and correlation verification before accepting the reply.
invariants: A retransmission of one business action retains the same command/idempotency identity.
The consumer selector and received JMSCorrelationID are both tied to the command identity.
Human-readable detail is not parsed as business authority; structured fields drive behavior.
Transport success does not move bank authority into the Java ATM or JMS bridge.
correct: Bound receive time and surface timeout as a transport failure.
Verify the returned correlation ID before parsing the response as the requested result.
